title: 第3章 抽卡抽出来的主角第4章 我弟仙帝转世有厌庶癖
slug: 穿越庶长兄嫡弟竟是仙帝转世
content_zh:
云擎闻言，脸上适当露出一抹感激的神情，再次抱拳道：“谢少君。”他垂眸，重瞳深处，一丝计划得逞的微光悄然敛去。
被二长老形容为历来沉稳的人，内心小人却在勾勾画画：《我的仙帝弟弟攻略手册》第一步，成功?。
高台上，大长老云彻缓缓吐出一口浊气，沉声道：“天佑云氏。”二长老云渊也终于忍不住哈哈大笑起来，畅快无比。
其他长老们神色也都轻松了一些，家族最不愿见到的，便是这两位天骄内斗。
台下不少庶出子弟，眼中不由得燃起了希望，自云煌掌权，族中庶出的日子实在是不好过。唯有云厉脸色复杂，心中滋味难明。
云煌注视着台下那道沉稳如古松的身影，心中因对方不循常理而生出的细微涟漪渐复平静。
他缓缓起身，在周围一声声敬畏的“恭送少君”中拂袖离场。
“混沌道胎，上古重瞳……有些意思。”云煌心中低语，“看来，你比本君预想的，还要有趣得多。呵，大长老他们藏的倒是深，怕本君对你下手？”
“免你跪礼，不过是看你天赋尚可，姿态也算得体。是忠是奸，是璞玉还是顽石，尚需岁月打磨，本君，拭目以待。”
云煌本人虽极度厌恶庶出，却也欣赏真正的天才。如今看来，此代之中唯一还算能与他比肩的，唯有这位“兄长”了。
云擎首次回族，便以这种石破天惊的方式，悍然宣告了他的归来，也将所有的不服与质疑彻底碾碎。这道投入命途湖面的涟漪是终将归于平静，还是酝酿成滔天巨浪，唯有时间能给出答案。
玄玉座上的主宰已然离去，测灵大典的余波，却在云氏年轻一代中彻底炸开。
“混沌道胎、上古重瞳。祖宗诶，您可真是偏心眼，这是能长在一个人身上的吗？！”
“是我等坐井观天了……”
“列祖列宗保佑，我媳妇怀孕了，不求像大公子一样，有一半就行啊，保佑保佑。”
有惊叹、有崇拜、还有当场开始拜的。各种情绪流转，缠绕在云擎挺拔的身躯上。
他静立原地，玄衣无风自动，面容古井无波。重瞳深处，混沌源气似星云流转，将周遭一切细微的情绪波纹与灵力涟漪尽数映照，清晰得如同掌中观纹，却又未曾在他心湖掀起半分波澜。
“大哥！”
一声压抑不住的雀跃呼唤打破沉寂，只见一个小童像挣脱樊笼的幼犬，快步蹿至他身前，眼眸亮得惊人：“大哥！外面都在传你呢，你太厉害了！”
旁边的妙龄女子，云氏三房庶女云瑶也跟着小跑过来，对云擎微微行礼，“云擎大哥”。

云擎朝云瑶微微点头，又垂眸看向这只同母所出的幼弟，云烁。记忆中那个瑟缩的小身影，如今眉宇间终于染上了他这个年纪应有的飞扬。自己的归来，能让云烁在族里的日子好过不少。
云擎抬手，指尖掠过云烁柔软的发顶，温和开口：“虚名而已。修行之路，重在自身。你需勤勉，莫要被外物所扰。”重瞳同时扫向一旁的少女，显然这句话也是对她说的。
“我知道的，大哥。”云烁用力点头。
“是，云擎大哥”云瑶声音压得很低，眼圈红了红，带着几分后怕，“可是大哥，少君他对庶出……之前云厉哥就因为回话时慢了片刻，便被少君…云厉哥丹田受创，至今还未痊愈。”
“慎言。”云擎打断她，目光倏然抬升，再次投向云煌离去的方向，重瞳深处闪过一丝极深的忌惮，“少君意志，便是云氏天规。”
云烁和云瑶被他话语中的凛冽惊住，连忙噤声。
正此时，二长老云渊缓步而来，脸上满是毫不掩饰的欣慰和赞赏。他目光扫过云擎全身，颔首道：“心性沉凝，如山岳难撼；应对得体，似静水流深。不错，不错，擎小子，甚好。”他这话看似评价今日表现，目光却与不远处负手而立的大长老云彻有了一瞬的交汇。
两位长老眼中满是心照不宣——不愧是“溯魂秘仪”遴选出的灵魂，与这混沌道胎、上古重瞳，果然是天作之合，完美承载我云氏的古老荣光。
“二长老谬赞，擎愧不敢当。”云擎躬身，姿态谦逊恭谨。
“哼，装模作样的臭小子，随我来吧，你的‘擎宇殿’早已备好。”云渊嗤笑一声，一甩袍袖，转身在前方引路。
云擎告别云瑶，拎着云烁，跟随二长老穿过重重殿宇。所过之处，无论是巡逻护卫还是偶遇的族中子弟，无不立刻躬身行礼，眼中充满敬畏。
踏入“擎宇殿”，殿内空间开阔，雕梁画栋，极尽古朴与奢华。浓郁的天地灵气氤氲升腾，几乎凝成实质，几不逊于他苦修十余载的混沌古洞。
告别二长老，挥退侍立的弟子，只留下对殿内充满好奇的云烁。
云擎独自立于窗前，望着窗外灵雾氤氲。此方世界，与他怀念的前世故乡截然不同。
东域云氏传承亘古，底蕴深不可测，那名为“溯魂秘仪”的古老灌顶之法，便是其核心隐秘之一。
此法能为家族最顶尖的血脉，从无尽时空长河中牵引匹配最契合的灵魂，也就是俗称的，穿越者！
他与云煌，皆非此界原生之魂。
云煌暂且不提，云擎的灵魂印记源自一颗蔚蓝星球。被溯魂秘仪选中后，胎穿于此方强者为尊的浩瀚世界。
他降生之初，混沌道胎与上古重瞳同时觉醒，引发天地异象，震动家族。二长老云渊亲自接引他入混沌古洞中，隔绝尘世，潜心修行。
十几载秘境苦修，云擎修为远超同龄，可今日与云煌短暂交锋，差距竟仍如天堑。

感知着那道缠绕在云煌命格之上，如星河般璀璨而且不可撼动的“天命”。云擎遥望窗外群山，重瞳幽深难测：‘他果然并非简单的天命之子，而是……仙元转世！’（↓避雷见下方作话喵↓）

When Yun Qing heard this, a look of gratitude appeared on his face, he clasped his fists again and said, "Thank you, Young Master." He lowered his eyes, and in the depths of his eyes, a glimmer of success in his plan quietly disappeared.
The second elder described him as a person who has always been calm, but the villain in his heart is sketching: "My Immortal Emperor Brother Strategy Manual" The first step, success?.
On the high platform, the eldest elder Yun Che slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air and said in a deep voice: "God bless the Yun family." The second elder Yun Yuan finally couldn't help but burst out laughing, extremely joyful.
The other elders also looked a little more relaxed. The last thing the family wanted to see was the internal fighting between these two geniuses.
Many of the common people in the audience couldn't help but have hope in their eyes. Since Yunhuang came to power, the life of the common people in the clan has been really difficult. Only Yun Li's face was complicated, and the feeling in his heart was hard to understand.
Yunhuang stared at the figure who was as calm as an ancient pine under the stage, and the subtle ripples in his heart caused by the other person's unreasonableness gradually calmed down.
He stood up slowly and left with a wave of his sleeves amid awed "Farewell Young Master" shouts from around him.
"Chaos Dao Fetus, Ancient Eyes... There is something interesting." Yunhuang whispered in his heart, "It seems that you are much more interesting than I expected. Ha, the Great Elder and the others are hiding deep, are they afraid that I will attack you?"
"I don't want you to kneel down, but it just depends on how talented you are and how decent your posture is. Whether you are loyal or traitorous, whether you are a jade or a stone, it still needs time to polish you. I will wait and see."
Although Yunhuang himself hated common people, he also appreciated true geniuses. Now it seems that the only one in this generation who can still compare with him is this "elder brother".
When Yun Qing returned to his clan for the first time, he declared his return in such a shocking way, completely crushing all dissatisfaction and doubts. Whether the ripples thrown into the lake of fate will eventually calm down or brew into huge waves, only time can tell the answer.
The master on the Xuanyu Seat has left, but the aftermath of the Spiritual Testing Ceremony has completely exploded among the younger generation of the Yun family.
"Chaos Dao Embryo, Ancient Eyes. Ancestor, you are really partial. Can this happen to one person?!"
"I'm just waiting to sit in a well and look at the sky..."
"My ancestors bless you, my wife is pregnant. I don't want to be like the eldest son, just half of it will be fine. Bless me."
Some were amazed, some worshiped, and some started to pray on the spot. Various emotions flowed around Yun Qing's tall and straight body.
He stood quietly on the spot, his mysterious clothes were windless and his face was as calm as ever. Deep in his double pupils, the source of chaos flowed like a nebula, reflecting all the subtle emotional ripples and spiritual energy ripples around him, as clear as the lines in the palm of his hand, but it did not cause any waves in his heart.
"Brother!"
An irrepressible cry of joy broke the silence, and a child, like a puppy breaking free from its cage, quickly jumped up to him, his eyes bright astonishingly: "Brother! People are spreading word about you outside, you are so awesome!"
The young woman next to him, Yun Yao, the third concubine of the Yun family, also trotted over and saluted Yun Qing slightly, "Brother Yun Qing."
Yun Qing nodded slightly towards Yun Yao, then lowered his eyes to look at the younger brother from the same mother, Yun Shuo. The shrunken little figure in his memory now finally has the elegance he deserves at his age between his brows. His return will make Yun Shuo's life in the clan much easier.
Yun Qing raised his hand, brushed the top of Yun Shuo's soft hair with his fingertips, and said gently: "It's just a false name. The path of cultivation is all about yourself. You need to be diligent and don't be disturbed by external things." His heavy eyes glanced at the girl aside at the same time, obviously this sentence was also meant for her.
"I know, brother." Yun Shuo nodded vigorously.
"Yes, Brother Yun Qing." Yun Yao's voice was very low, her eyes were red, and she was a little scared, "But brother, Shaojun, he came out to the concubine... Before, Brother Yunli was a little slow in replying, so he was injured by Shaojun... Brother Yunli's pubic area has not recovered yet."
"Be careful what you say." Yun Qing interrupted her,His gaze suddenly raised, and he once again cast his gaze in the direction Yun Huang left. A trace of deep fear flashed in his eyes, "Young Master's will is the Yun Family's Heavenly Rules."
Yun Shuo and Yun Yao were shocked by the harshness in his words and quickly fell silent.
At this time, the second elder Yunyuan came slowly, his face full of unabashed relief and appreciation. He glanced at Yun Qing's whole body, nodded and said: "A calm mind is as hard to shake as a mountain; a proper response is like still water running deep. Yes, yes, young man Qing, very good." His words seemed to be evaluating today's performance, but his eyes met for a moment with the great elder Yun Che, who was standing not far away with his hands behind his back.
There was a tacit understanding in the eyes of the two elders - they are indeed the souls selected by the "Soul Tracing Mystery". With this chaotic Tao embryo and ancient eyes, they are indeed a match made in heaven, perfectly carrying the ancient glory of my Yun family.
"The second elder is so complimentary that I don't deserve it." Yun Qing bowed with a humble and respectful attitude.
"Hmph, you pretentious brat, come with me, your 'Qingyu Palace' has already been prepared." Yunyuan sneered, flicked his sleeves, turned around and led the way.
Yun Qing said goodbye to Yun Yao, carried Yun Shuo, and followed the second elder through the many palaces. Wherever they passed, whether they were patrolling guards or the clan members they met by chance, they all immediately bowed and saluted, their eyes full of awe.
Stepping into the "Qingyu Hall", the space inside the hall is wide, with carved beams and painted buildings, which is full of simplicity and luxury. The rich spiritual energy of heaven and earth rose densely, almost condensing into substance, almost no less than the ancient chaotic cave where he had been practicing hard for more than ten years.
He bid farewell to the second elder and dismissed the disciples standing there, leaving only Yun Shuo who was full of curiosity about the hall.
Yun Qing stood alone in front of the window, looking out at the mist. This world is completely different from the hometown he missed in his previous life.
The Yun Sect of the Eastern Region has an ancient inheritance, and its foundation is unfathomable. The ancient initiation method called "Soul Tracing Mystery" is one of its core secrets.
This method can draw and match the most suitable soul for the top bloodline of the family from the endless river of time and space, which is also commonly known as the time traveler!
Neither he nor Yun Huang are native souls of this world.
Leaving Yunhuang aside for now, Yunqing’s soul imprint comes from a blue planet. After being selected by the Soul Tracing Mystery, he was born into a vast world where the strong were respected.
When he was born, the chaotic Tao fetus and the ancient eyes awakened at the same time, causing strange phenomena in the world and shocking the family. The second elder, Yunyuan, personally led him into the Ancient Cave of Chaos, where he isolated himself from the world and devoted himself to cultivation.
After more than ten years of hard training in the secret realm, Yun Qing's cultivation was far beyond that of his age. However, in today's brief confrontation with Yun Huang, the gap was still as big as the sky.
Feeling the "destiny" that is as bright and unshakable as the galaxy, entwined in Yunhuang's destiny. Yun Qing looked at the mountains outside the window, his eyes were deep and unpredictable: 'He is indeed not a simple son of destiny, but... the reincarnation of immortal energy! ’ (↓See below for lightning protection↓)
